Swedbank Has Decreased Its Position in Apple INC (AAPL) by $59.48 Million as Share Price Rose March 6, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Investors sentiment increased to 0.7 in 2017 Q3. Its up 0.02, from 0.68 in 2017Q2. It is positive, as 52 investors sold AAPL shares while 1034 reduced holdings. 116 funds opened positions while 640 raised stakes. 2.97 billion shares or 2.78% less from 3.06 billion shares in 2017Q2 were reported. Alliancebernstein Limited Partnership invested in 22.42 million shares or 2.59% of the stock. South Street Advsr Ltd Liability Com has 2.82% invested in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Hikari Tsushin invested in 0.36% or 7,975 shares. Magnetar Fincl Lc reported 0.05% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Macguire Cheswick And Tuttle Investment Counsel Limited Com holds 150,192 shares or 4.55% of its portfolio. Hirtle Callaghan And Limited Liability Corporation stated it has 0.47% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Torray Ltd Liability Corporation holds 147,891 shares or 2.26% of its portfolio. Moreover, Carlton Hofferkamp And Jenks Wealth Ltd Liability has 2.39% invested in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) for 24,320 shares. Moreover, Nj State Employees Deferred Compensation Plan has 4.4% invested in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Bremer Natl Association invested in 1.9% or 44,397 shares. Glenmede Trust Na reported 1.61% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Natl Planning Corporation has invested 5.65% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Northern Cap Mgmt Ltd Limited Liability Company invested in 52,207 shares. Arcadia Invest Mgmt Mi owns 55,416 shares. Ims Capital Management holds 1.39% or 14,105 shares.
Since October 3, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 selling transactions for $26.38 million activity. $8.79 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares were sold by SCHILLER PHILIP W. 63,388 shares were sold by AHRENDTS ANGELA J, worth $9.78 million.
Swedbank decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.53% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Swedbank sold 386,260 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 8.13M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.25B, down from 8.52 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Swedbank who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $897.19 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.61 $176.82. About 28.40 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
Swedbank, which manages about $16.35 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 816,414 shares to 11.50 million shares, valued at $856.53 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Facebook (NASDAQ:FB) by 140,125 shares in the quarter, for a total of 3.63M shares, and has risen its stake in Applied Material (NASDAQ:AMAT).
